output.notes: Described the headline Falcon-180B (primary_config), whose block has two separate layer norms (attention and MLP branches) feeding parallel attention/MLP. Falcon-40B uses the same block. Falcon-7B uses a single shared layer norm ('For Falcon-7B (later trained), we switched to a single layer norm.') and multiquery (n_kv=1). Several values are left not_stated: MLP hidden width d_ff, layer norm eps, the GeLU form (exact vs tanh), the RoPE pairing, theta and fraction, the attention scale, and any final layer norm before the head. The final norm is therefore omitted from the head. Pre-norm placement is inferred from the statement that the layer norm weights merge into the subsequent linear layer. Multigroup attention uses n_kv=TP. z-loss is a training loss, not an architectural element. Ablation baselines (ALiBi, SwiGLU, GPT-3-like) are not the model.
